title: U.S. House · Texas's 18th District
area: Central Houston and parts of Harris County.

context.text: Christian Menefee won a November 4, 2025 special election to fill the seat after Rep. Sylvester Turner died in March 2025. For the 2026 general election, Menefee defeated fellow incumbent U.S. Rep. Al Green in a May 26, 2026 Democratic primary runoff, 69.3% to 30.7%, after the two topped a crowded March 3, 2026 primary field. Ronald Whitfield won the Republican nomination outright in the March 3, 2026 primary.

candidates.name: Christian Menefee
candidates.currentRole: U.S. Representative (since 2026); previously Harris County Attorney (2021–2025)

summary.text: Christian Menefee is the Democratic incumbent, having won a November 2025 special election to the seat and then defeated fellow incumbent Al Green in the May 2026 Democratic primary runoff. He previously served as Harris County Attorney.

background.text: Born in Petaluma, California; earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at San Antonio in 2010 and a law degree from Washington University in St. Louis School of Law in 2013.
Served as Harris County Attorney from 2021 to 2025, succeeding Vince Ryan.

record.text: Defeated incumbent U.S. Rep. Al Green in the May 26, 2026 Democratic primary runoff for this seat, 69.3% to 30.7%.
